text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Have you all put your luggage in your rooms? Okay then, now to review our itinerary for summer camp—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I have a plan! I have a plan!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I wanna smash watermelons!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, you. Shouldn't we be focusing on training first?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Nature is right. First, we will be tackling this training regimen I put together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However, watermelons are rich in water, minerals, vitamins, and sugar content, making them good for preventing heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: So, I'll make use of your suggestion. We'll eat some watermelon during our breaks.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right. I figured you would say something like that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Splitting watermelons… One time, I tripped and fell into a sand pit. I landed flat on my face, and my nose got all bloody. Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: In that case, you have to nosebleed-proof yourself before the next time you fall over!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: You can put an inner tube around your face! Problem solved! I'm such a genius!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?! You want me to split watermelons wearing an inner tube around my face?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm… Well, I guess it would protect me when falling over…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You're going to worry yourself sick. I'll keep watch so you don't trip and fall.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But more importantly… how about giving Ikuno some suggestions for our training plans?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: …Give me a second. I'm adjusting our schedule to make room for watermelon splitting.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I know! Let's play some beach volleyball! And then we can have a barbecue and go to a festival!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that'd be… Wait, that's all fun and games!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: As long as we complete our training as planned, that shouldn't be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: In fact, within reason, I'd say it works to keep us from burning out. It may do us some good to see the fireworks, too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wait, really?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …It looks like Ikuno's getting a little giddy herself.
